receipt_footer.description: Text at the end of the receipt

next_receipt.description: Next receipt number (only forward once there are sales)

currency.description: ISO code (only before the first sale)

currency_digits.description: Minor digits (only before the first sale)

cash_round_to.description: Cash rounding step, like 0.05 (0 for none)

denominations.description: JSON list of notes and coins for counting, like ["100","50","20","10","5","1","0.25"]

tip_presets.description: JSON list of up to 5 percentages, like [10, 15, 20]

tip_basis.description: Tip on the amount before or after tax

card_reference.description: Ask for the card terminal approval code

tenders.description: JSON list of the store's own tenders: [{"label": "Bank transfer"}] (keep ids to keep them)

points_per_unit.description: Points earned per 1 unit of currency spent

point_value.description: What 1 point is worth when spent, like 0.01

allow_negative_stock.description: Sell items even when stock says none

low_stock_default.description: Low stock level for items without their own

lock_idle_minutes.description: Lock the register after this many idle minutes (0 never)

auto_shift_review.description: Ask your AI agent to review each closed drawer

show_tile_prices.description: Show each product's price under its name on the sell screen's tiles
